verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Glama's gateway offers per-tool enable/disable controls and states that calls are 'credential-managed'. Neither of these documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (keys or tokens) to an agent. Per-tool toggles are an adjacent access control, not a scoped-credential capability, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
